tbesh_html:
1) to go astray, err, commit sin or error
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to err (mentally)
1a2) to sin (ignorantly or inadvertently)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to stray, i.e. (figuratively) sin (with more or less apology)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: [idiom] also for that, deceived, err, go astray, sin ignorantly.
